subject: Probe dataset handoff — risk assessment, escrow options, and close cadence
messages:
From: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@brightkart.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 9 May 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Probe dataset handoff — quick Qs before we send

Hey Sean,

Thanks again for the demo last week. We're ready to move forward with the mutual action plan and to provide a small probe dataset + promptpack so your team can run the evaluation sweep. Before we upload anything, two quick things from our side: 

1) We need confirmation of the sandbox TTL and token/credential rotation cadence for ephemeral assets.
2) Our security team wants to see an outline of redaction steps you expect us to perform (PII, account ids) and whether Redwood will run any additional automated PII scans post-ingest.

I'll attach a zipped sample of the probe testcases and our preliminary redaction slate in the next email. Can we aim to have the MAP signed and first-run results within two weeks of transfer? That timeline would align with our Q2 pilot.

—Liam
BrightKart (evaluation lead)

Attachments referenced: probe-testcases-v1.zip, privacy-redaction-checklist.pdf
From: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.ai>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@brightkart.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 11 May 2026 10:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Probe dataset handoff — quick Qs before we send

Liam —

Great timing. We can support an ephemeral sandbox with a default 14-day TTL and automated token rotation every 48 hours. We also have options to shorten the TTL if you want a tighter window for the evaluation. Key points: 

- Access model: short-lived API keys tied to the sandbox project; keys expire and are auto-rotated.
- Auditability: every request is logged (token-level) and retained per the MAP; we can export logs to your DR.
- PII scanning: we will run an automated PII heuristic pass after ingest and flag items for manual review. We do not perform irreversible transformation on your source files without explicit approval.

For redaction, see the attached checklist from your note — we'll run our scanners and share a report before the first evaluation run.

Timeline: if you send files by EOD Wednesday (13 May), we can complete ingest + initial scan by Friday and run the first evaluation by the following Wednesday (20 May). If that works, I'll circulate a short MAP addendum and a DocuSign link for signatures.

I'll loop in Connor on the ingestion specifics and Lauren for compliance sign-off.

Thanks,
Sean
Director, Strategic Sales
Redwood Inference

Attachments referenced: privacy-redaction-checklist.pdf
From: Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.ai>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@brightkart.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 12 May 2026 08:32:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Probe dataset handoff — ingestion & sandbox ops

Liam — quick operational notes to prepare the upload: 

1) Upload method: SFTP to a temporary bucket we provision (instructions below) OR direct Drive share to the Redwood ingestion mailbox. We prefer SFTP for larger archives.
2) File manifest: Include a CSV manifest (filename, record_count, sample_label, redaction_status). That speeds validation.
3) Redaction: If you follow your attached checklist, we will only run a QA scan to verify redaction completeness; items flagged will be returned for your remediation unless you instruct us otherwise.
4) Sandbox TTL is configurable per-project. We'll default to 14 days; confirm if you want 7 or 3 days.
5) Escrow option: For customers who want an independent escrow, we can deposit a copy of the probe corpus into a third-party escrow (standard fee) with release conditions tied to the signed MPA and acceptance gate. Let us know if you want a quote.

Operational next steps: Liam, send the archive + manifest and confirm TTL. Lauren — do we need an internal compliance checklist sign-off for a 14-day ephemeral sandbox?

—Connor
Platform Ops, Redwood Inference

SFTP details: sftp://ingest.reddemo.com/brightkart_probes (we'll send creds once you confirm)
From: BrightKart Legal <legal@brightkart.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.ai>, Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 14 May 2026 12:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Probe dataset handoff — contract questions

Sean / Connor —

Reviewing the MPA draft. A few points from legal we need clarified before signature: 

- Data usage: BrightKart requires that probe assets be used exclusively for the stated evaluation and not retained for model training or benchmarking beyond the acceptance window. Please confirm the destruction / retention policy and provide an auditable proof-of-destruction process.
- Escrow: We want the escrow option but require the escrow agent to be an independent party (not Redwood-operated). Please provide vendor options and costs.
- Audit logs: Need a 90-day retention minimum for request logs tied to this evaluation.

Please reply with explicit language we can include in the MPA. We prefer to get these items inline in the DocuSign flow for a single-signature close.

—Asha Mehta
Legal Counsel, BrightKart

Forwarded attachments: mpa-draft-20260509.docx
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
To: Asha Mehta <asha.mehta@brightkart.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.ai>, Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 15 May 2026 09:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Probe dataset handoff — legal points & retention

Hi Asha —

Thanks — a few clarifications that address your bullets: 

- Retention & destruction: Redwood will retain evaluation artifacts (models/derived outputs) for 7 days post-run by default. We can extend log retention to 90 days for this engagement (at no extra cost) and commit to a signed destruction confirmation (MD5 checks and disposal report) once the escrow window closes. We'll include language: "Redwood will not use probe assets or derived model checkpoints for training or benchmarking outside the scope of the MAP; any retained artifacts will be destroyed within the agreed retention window and a destruction report will be provided to BrightKart."
- Escrow: We can provide a list of independent escrow vendors (IronBox Escrow, Valutis, and NeutralStore). We'll include vendor quotes in a follow-up.
- Audit logs: we will configure a 90-day export to your S3 if you prefer, or share monthly snapshots to your SIEM.

If that meets your requirements, Sean will push an updated MPA docx into DocuSign and we can capture all edits inline.

—Lauren
Head of Compliance, Redwood Inference
From: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.ai>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@brightkart.com>, Asha Mehta <asha.mehta@brightkart.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 20 May 2026 15:43:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Probe dataset handoff — risk assessment, escrow options, and close cadence

Team —

Thanks for the quick turnaround. Next steps we agreed: 

1) BrightKart to upload probe-testcases-v1.zip + manifest to the SFTP by EOD Monday (24 May).
2) Redwood to perform automated PII scan and share a remediation report within 48 hours of ingest.
3) Redwood will provision an ephemeral sandbox with a 14-day TTL and 48-hour token rotation. Lauren has agreed to map out the destruction proof language for the MPA; we'll include the 90-day log retention and independent escrow vendor list in the DocuSign package.
4) DocuSign link (one-click): https://docusign.com/embedded/BRIGHT-4891 — we'll push the updated MPA with the inline legal language and request a single execution to keep the close timeline tight.

If no objections, I'll mark the MAP status as "Awaiting customer upload & signature" in HubSpot (DEAL-4891) and we will kick ingestion on receipt.

Appreciate the collaboration — aiming for first-run results by 03 Jun if upload is on Monday.

—Sean
Director, Strategic Sales
Redwood Inference
